mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 6 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for the prior 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tight labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has been below 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 6-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 6-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a federal funds rate rise above 5.0% triggers monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals expanding labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased for the prior 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has been below 100.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) above their 12-month moving averages indicate accelerating economic demand, increasing corporate revenue expectations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 3.0% YoY), a federal funds rate decline below 4.5% triggers monetary easing that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL < 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS < 4.5%.
